Name: GrassKeeper
Author: Malenyaaa
Description:
Description
Since 1.6, grass can grow under fences, machines and other things you place, and it looks nice there. But every swing of the scythe along a fence line mows it away again.

With this mod, your scythe leaves the grass under placed things alone. Grass on open ground is cut as usual, so you still get your hay.

Unlike mods that protect all grass, this only keeps the grass that sits under something:
- fences and gates
- placed objects: machines, chests, sprinklers, scarecrows, signs and so on
- furniture placed outside, like benches or lamps

Weeds, stones, twigs, forage and dig spots don't count, so grass under them is cut normally.

By default swords and daggers leave the grass alone too. Bombs still blow it away.

Installation instructions
1. Install SMAPI.
2. Unzip the mod into your Mods folder.
3. Start the game through SMAPI.

To change the settings, edit config.json (created on first launch) or use Generic Mod Config Menu.

Main features
- Grass under fences and gates stays when you use the scythe
- Same for machines, chests, sprinklers, signs and outdoor furniture
- Grass on open ground is still cut, so you still get hay
- Works in multiplayer and split-screen; each player only needs it for their own scythe
- English and German
- Enabled: turns the mod on or off.
- UnderFences: keeps the grass under fences and gates.
- UnderObjects: keeps the grass under placed objects like machines, chests, sprinklers or signs.
- UnderFurniture: keeps the grass under furniture placed outside.
- AllWeapons: swords and daggers leave the grass alone too. When off, only scythes do.

Requirements
- Stardew Valley 1.6 or newer
- SMAPI 4.0 or newer (required)
- Generic Mod Config Menu (optional, only to change the settings in-game)

AI disclosure: This mod was made with the help of an AI coding assistant (Claude by Anthropic). I came up with the idea, decided how it should behave, tested it in-game and reviewed the result. The AI wrote most of the code.

Source code (MIT): https://github.com/Malenyaaa/stardew-mods
